sources.title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking
sources.snippet: Each loop lets the model revise its hidden state before it commits to an answer, without generating a token; we call this System 1.5 thinking. We propose SanSi, which turns a pre-trained looped language model into a typed decision model.
